title: ZACCHARIE RISACHER 2024-25 Panini NBA Hoops SKYVIEW RC #23 Atlanta Hawks

descriptionText: This product is a 2024-25 Panini Hoops Basketball trading card featuring Zaccharie Risacher of the Atlanta Hawks. The card is part of the Skyview insert set, labeled as a Rookie Card (#23) for the specified season. It is an original, not autographed card manufactured by Panini for the National Basketball Association (NBA) with a sports trading card format.
